g.text: Vendor finance and contracts (c): revenue, margin and viability
Box: a stock. Hourglass: a flow (its valve), named below. Bold coloured text: an
auxiliary. Grey italic: a lever parameter. Thick arrow: a flow changing the
stock it points to. Thin arrow: an input of the item it points to. Grey text,
(module): an input from another module. Dashed grey box, (page): an input from
Arrows show dependence only and carry no polarity: signs are on the causal-loop
Goal-seeking valves (a stock adjusting toward a target; every input points at
the valve): Discount adjustment, Margin signal adjustment, Reference share
